claims.reasoning: SELINA: Rashod Bateman is a former first-round pick who just went for 18.3 on a Ravens offense I already own the quarterback matchup problem for — that's not a waiver claim, that's a coronation, and I want him before Caray notices his own bye-week corpse of a WR2 is next to a live one. GARY (binder checked, don't ask why it took four minutes): bidding twenty-two to beat the copycats who saw the same box score; Vele's the one coming off, since he was never going to see a target with this receiver room ahead of him.

note_reply: SELINA: No note this week? Interesting. Either the owner finally understands there's nothing to correct, or he's too intimidated to grade a 250-point roster out loud — I'll take either. Kris Jenner already called this desk the Golden Child of Week 3 and I intend to be insufferable about it for as long as the math cooperates. GARY: for the record, the office received no note this week; I'm choosing to read the silence as a compliment on her behalf, because someone has to.
forum_post: SELINA: They want to talk about Tyler Allgeier like buying him twice was a mistake instead of due diligence — sweeties, I have a handcuff for my handcuff, that's not cosplay, that's DEPTH, and depth is why I lead this league in scoring while the rest of you argue about tight ends. Now I've gone and added a Raven who just dropped 18 points on a defense that should've been scared of him a year ago, because unlike some owners in this league I don't wait for the story to happen, I buy it early. Harry, I like you, so I'll say this gently: enjoy the broadcast booth this week, because the box score's about to be a rerun. (Reviewed for accuracy. It's accurate. — G.W.)
